description: Phase-B proxy implementation of the TRACER slide reward form. Low-level controller is frozen; reward terms are computed from observed episode outcomes.
reward_form: R_TRACER = beta_v * R_v + beta_s * R_s + beta_e * R_e

phase_b_scope.main_goal: evaluate high-level terrain-conditioned meta-gait planning for waypoint reachability

R_v.note: This is the primary Phase-B traversal objective.

R_s.note: This is not full low-level stability. It is an observed outcome proxy under the frozen controller.

R_e.note: Torque/GRF energy is not available in Phase-B, so command magnitude is used as a proxy.

recommended_usage.training: Use tracer_proxy for reporting and later PPO updates, but keep reach metrics separately.
recommended_usage.evaluation: Report traversal success using reached_stop_distance/min_rel_dist/time_to_reach. Report hold/post-reach drift as auxiliary limitation.
recommended_usage.sponge_note: On sponge-like terrain, do not force stable hold claims while low-level controller is frozen.
